i18n.enSummary: As the number of applications increases, HR is burdened with scheduling and conducting initial interviews, and are you worried about the disparity in evaluations among interviewers? One solution is an AI interviewer, in which AI is responsible for some of the questioning and evaluation. However, if you introduce AI without determining the scope of what you want to entrust to AI and its operational rules, you will not be able to reach internal consensus regarding explanations to candidates and the handling of personal information.
